title: SignatureTierWrapper
description: The tiered-signature wire shape (src/protocol.zig Signature struct + Stage tier wrapping). Spike target #3: closed-enum algorithm picklist + opaque bytes value, wrapped by the Stage lifecycle tier (seed | dreamball | dragonball). The 'tier wrapper' is the Stage enum that tags which lifecycle tier signed; the inner Signature pair is the alg + value the dCBOR `signed` attribute carries.

alg.$comment: Closed enum: ed25519 | ml-dsa-87. Picklist at the Valibot layer.

value.$comment: Opaque signature bytes — Ed25519 = 64 B, ML-DSA-87 = 4627 B.

Stage.$comment: The tier wrapper. seed = pre-signing; dreamball = signed; dragonball = sealed. Lives at the Envelope.stage layer (see envelope schema), referenced here so consumers can co-validate tier-and-signature presence.
